title: Premier Money Market Levels and the Goodwill Share Applied to Personal Checking Overdraft Charges
content:
The goodwill relief is settled only once the account stands on the tier its relationship balance supports.

**Clause.** The share of the relief pool given back on a Personal Checking account moves with the goodwill refund allowance of the tier in force, with the owner's premier money market balance held under Savings & Money Market Accounts, with the overdraft charges standing on the account and with card payments under Personal Credit Cards.

1. Where the tier allows at least 3 goodwill refunds in a rolling year **and** the owner's premier money market balance reaches the protection source minimum of 5000.00, the goodwill share is a deep relief share of 0.6.
2. Where the case above does not apply **and** either at least 3 overdraft charges stand on the account **or** the owner has made at least 6 card payments in the last twelve months, it is a standard relief share of 0.4.
3. Where neither case applies, neither of those shares is used.

The goodwill refund allowance is the tier's own figure:

| Tier | Goodwill refunds allowed in any rolling 365 days |
|---|---|
| Access Checking | 1 |
| Student Checking | 1 |
| Everyday Checking | 1 |
| Interest Checking | 2 |
| Premier Checking | 3 |
| Private Client Checking | 6 |

Only Premier Checking and Private Client Checking allow 3 or more, so only those tiers can reach the first case.

**Worked shares on hypothetical inputs.** On a relief pool of 90.00:

| Owner's position | Relief pool taken at the goodwill share |
|---|---|
| Premier Checking, premier money market balance of 9000.00 | 54.00 |
| Premier Checking, premier money market balance of 400.00, 4 overdraft charges standing | 36.00 |
| Everyday Checking, premier money market balance of 9000.00, 7 card payments | 36.00 |
| Everyday Checking, 1 overdraft charge standing, 2 card payments | Neither share is used |

The first case requires both of its limbs; the second is met by either limb alone. Equality satisfies each threshold, so an allowance of exactly 3 with a premier money market balance of exactly 5000.00 reaches the first case.
